backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profile storage, and an approval workflow with admin-only privileged actions.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report linking features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with high-confidence evidence entries.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten mapping of frontend file paths to short description summaries for use in build or documentation processes.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing build steps, approval-gating verification, rollback, troubleshooting, and expected console logs.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules defining role-based access, admin and super_admin permissions, and strict create/update constraints for user profiles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base configuration defining global OKLCH color variables, dark mode overrides, and shared styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: Bootstraps the app, loads Firebase via CDN, initializes Firebase services, and mounts the React app.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: Step-by-step live smoke test checklist covering signup flows, approval gating, admin approval, login behavior, and caching checks.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines client-side routing logic and renders screens based on path using React state and QueryClient.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Provides admin action dropdowns for approving, blocking, and changing user roles with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Checks Firestore user profile and only renders children for admin or super_admin roles.
Layout wrapper for authentication screens with centered content and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the app header with logo, user avatar, and profile menu once user profile loads.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: Dropdown menu showing user info, admin dashboard link for admins, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: Listens to Firebase auth state changes via CDN-loaded modules and exposes current authenticated user.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Fetches the Firestore user profile for the logged-in user using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Fetches all users and provides mutations for approving users or updating roles with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, including login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: Wraps CDN-loaded Firebase, provides helpers for auth, Firestore access, user profile creation, and checking first-user roles.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase auth and Firestore error codes to human-readable messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for user profiles and signup data.
Processes profile images by resizing, compressing, validating size, and returning a preview data URL.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides a utility function to merge class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin page placeholder for future chat management with protected access.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Admin dashboard showing user statistics from Firestore with loading states.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Shared admin layout providing sidebar navigation, mobile menu, and content wrapper.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Admin reports placeholder screen indicating upcoming analytics features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Admin settings placeholder screen for future configuration options.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Admin interface for viewing and managing users, roles, and approval status using Firestore data.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Displays a welcome message and basic dashboard cards using the user’s Firestore profile.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Implements email/password login flow with error handling, approval checks, and navigation callbacks.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: UI-only password reset form that logs the request and shows an admin-handled confirmation message.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup form with profile photo capture/upload, validation, Firebase sign‑up, and camera integration.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom colors, layout settings, animations, and typography/container-query plugins.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s metadata, architectural notes, feature list, and image requirements for the Firebase‑based role-managed app.
